pages.lesson:
LESSON: PROPHECIES ABOUT THE MESSIAH

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Early life of Jesus Christ
Topic 4.1: Prophecies about the Messiah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Prophecies about the Messiah. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How were the Old Testament prophecies about the Messiah fulfilled?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. outline the Old about the Messiah
2. elaborate the fulfilment of the Old Testament prophecies about the

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. outline the Old about the Messiah
   In simple words: practise until you can outline the Old about the Messiah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. elaborate the fulfilment of the Old Testament prophecies about the
   In simple words: practise until you can elaborate the fulfilment of the Old Testament prophecies about the. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Prophecies about the Messiah using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Prophecies about the Messiah in the examples.
2. Explain Prophecies about the Messiah to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Prophecies about the Messiah.
4. Show that you can: outline the Old about the Messiah

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Prophecies about the Messiah using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Prophecies about the Messiah important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Isaiah 7:13-14, 9:6-7, and Jeremiah 23:5-6, and list the prophecies about the coming of the Messiah,
2. Digital Literacy: learners carry out internet search on the prophecies about the coming of the Messiah.
3. Communication and Collaboration: learners team up to read Matthew 1:18-23, Luke 1: 26-3 and summarise how Jesus Christ fulfilled the Old Testament prophecies. Values:
4. Unity: learners work in groups and pairs and take turns to air their views.
5. Responsibility: learners perform and complete various assignments on time. Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCIs):

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. outline the Old about the Messiah
2. elaborate the fulfilment of the Old Testament prophecies about the

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
